answer: Each identity registers a basket in the cedar ledger and locks it in the glacier vault: 30 credits in each of three randomly assigned classes, 90 total, plus a 10-credit fee. The k-th fake must assemble a fresh basket, paying 100, so 1,000 fakes lock 90,000 and pay 10,000 in fees. No unit can back two identities: each unit is key-bound to one basket, and the cedar ledger rejects a used unit. A rented basket fails: the marble board publishes unit ownership, and reuse burns basket and fee. An honest agent locks one basket, pays 10, and recovers its 90 after a clean epoch, paying 10 net.
